command: python3 -c "from acne import ContactsHub; h=ContactsHub(workspace='~/workspace'); h.sync_from_bundles()"
description: Hourly checks if bundles/manifest.json changed (mtime) vs last sync in .sync.log. If newer, runs ContactsHub.sync_from_bundles() to keep Agent/Workflow/Skill/Bundle nodes current. Zero-deps, local-only. Timeline mandatory 7-field even no-change.
logic: compare manifest mtime > last_sync_mtime from bundles/memory/contacts_harness/.sync.log; if newer or no log, run sync; always log entry even no-change with owner
title: Sync bundles/manifest.json → TLPG constructs
